name: comp-476
title: Feature Compatibility Table
description: A feature support matrix: three CSS features run down the left, ten desktop and mobile browsers run across the top in sideways labels, and each cell holds a green tick or red cross with the version number.
use: Developers need to show at a glance which browsers support a short list of web features.
avoid: The three features and their 2024-era versions are fixed in the file, so your own data means a source edit.
a11y: Icons are hidden from screen readers but each cell adds hidden "Supported" or "Not supported" text, and both browser groups have hidden headings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dense grid of faint white cell borders on black. Browser names are rotated to read bottom-to-top along the top edge, with a monitor icon over the desktop half and a phone icon over the mobile half. Feature names sit left, and every cell pairs a small green tick or red cross with a grey version number.
behaves: Almost nothing moves: hovering a row tints that whole strip of cells a slightly lighter grey so the eye can track across all ten browsers. No cell is clickable.
customise: Features, browser lists and support flags sit in an items array inside the file; adding a feature or changing versions is a source edit, while borders and text follow theme tokens.
weight: light: Three rows of plain cells with inline SVG icons; nothing animates.
